polityNote: Republic of the Philippines (independent since 1946-07-04). Units are provinces plus cities independent of a province (highly urbanized and independent component cities, as in the PSA PSGC); Metro Manila (NCR) is one unit. Unlegislated internal boundary disputes (e.g. Benguet-Ilocos Sur; Calauag, Quezon vs Santa Elena, Camarines Norte, settled 2001 for the administering side) are not treated as changes; NE lines are taken as the legal lines.
